_why: Recorded recall and precision per scored form. A ratchet, like the CSS ones: these only ever go DOWN by a deliberate edit that says why in its commit message. A number going up is free and should be re-recorded in the same change that earned it, or the next change gets to lose it silently.
_readMe: src/editor/adapters/pdf/corpus/README.md, section 'The scored corpus'. MOBI-13 has the programme and the one decision still open.

pdkef-practice-form.note: Self-labelling: the nine AcroForm widgets are the truth, exact to the point. The one miss is the signature field, which collectTextFieldWidgets does not read by design (MOBI-11) - so this form reports a real scope line rather than a flattering 100%.

health.note: Scored against the annotated original (MOBI-13, 2026-09-20), and it reproduces the spike's recorded 86.7%/94.2% exactly. The 10 misses are real detector gaps, not artifacts: both dates and the signature line are kinds the detector does not report at all, and the two phone combs and the e-mail/clause text cells are boxes it does not close. Nothing here is a fixture caveat any more.

itc101.note: Scored against the annotated original (MOBI-13, 2026-09-20). Committing the original brought the text layer back, the scored corpus runs the pdf.js text pass the product runs, and MOBI-11's tick-column fix took checkbox recall from 0 to 87.1% and the form to 85.6%/96.7%. Then FORM-12 (2026-09-22): buildClosedCells scopes rows per column, so a stray rule from the boxes to the left of the children table (y=450.42 and friends) no longer splits its rows. That found all 12 of the table's cells (t043-t045, t053-t055, t058-t060, t063-t065: four name cells and eight tick cells, so the 8 checkbox misses were never drawn squares), text 70 -> 83.3 and checkbox 87.1 -> 100. Precision went DOWN deliberately, 96.7 -> 95.6: the same table's column-header row (captions 'מספר זהות' and 'שם', y 461.6-474.0) used to be split by a stray rule at 471.4 and hidden. Now it closes and its captions pass writableArea's side carve, which is 2 false positives, tracked as FORM-13. FORM-13 (2026-09-24) earned it back and one more: a side-carved caption whose own column continues as two or more identical empty rows is that column's heading, not a label beside a blank. It drops those two headers and the letter-spaced 'השינויים בפרטי' title over the changes table, so precision 95.6 -> 97.8 with recall held; over every page of every scored form those three and two column captions on this form's second page are the only cells it removes. The 3 false positives left are the e-mail cell and two cells on the changes table's third row that sit over its date and signature targets without matching them. The 8 misses left are 5 text cells (the private address row, the health fund name, the e-mail), 2 signature lines and 1 date.

irs-1040-2024.note: The first live AcroForm among the real scored forms, and 88 answer locations on one page rather than our practice form's nine. Read 100% the way the practice form's 88.9% is read: the truth is derived from the same widgets formWidgets.js reads, so a high recall here is structural, not earned. What it actually measures is the ink pass alongside the widget pass on a crowded page. FORM-12 (2026-09-22): the page body is one 492x666pt unstroked fill, and its left side at x=91.6 was read as a wall that split every field it crossed. Treating a filled, unstroked panel taller and wider than any row as background, not ink, found t004 (the one miss, which had fallen under IoU 0.5) and removed 4 false positives. It added one: the line 6c amount box, closed on all four sides but not in the truth, so 2 false positives remain, both printed-geometry cells the widgets do not corroborate. A drop here means the widget pass broke.

irs-1040-1970.note: A genuinely scanned page, and the only form here the detector cannot see at all. Its whole page is one CCITTFaxDecode image, so collectPageInk finds zero verticals, zero horizontals and zero rects: there is no vector ink to read, and 0 candidates is the honest answer rather than a fault to fix under MOBI-13. That is why precision is null rather than 0 - with nothing emitted there is nothing to be precise about. The zero is an assertion: scoring.test.js pins candidates at exactly 0, so the day a raster path finds anything here the row fails and has to be re-recorded by whoever earned it. The 64 targets are annotated by eye from the render and describe the form, so they are ready to measure against the moment that happens.
